##### Project general facts

Q Gardens Aliya by AYS Developers is a contemporary high-rise residential tower with a silver-toned facade and modern design. The tower rises above a ground floor and five podium parking levels to twenty-seven residential floors and a roof, offering a collection of stylish studios and one-bedroom apartments. Floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows bathe every home in natural light, while elegant finishes in cream tones create a bright, airy and refined atmosphere for everyday living.

Amenities are designed for relaxation, entertainment and wellness. Residents enjoy a heated rooftop swimming pool with jacuzzi, a fully equipped gym, a cycling studio and a steam and sauna area, along with a squash court and jogging paths. A cinema, an entertainment game room, indoor and outdoor children's play areas, a barbecue and grill area, a rooftop garden, a business space with a meeting room, an espresso bar and electric vehicle charging complete the offer.

Interiors combine premium finishes with Italian design, including Bertolotto Porte doors, Villeroy and Boch and Grohe sanitaryware, Schneider switches and Blum hinges. Furnished Italian kitchens feature Michelangelo backsplashes and countertops and sleek Siemens appliances, creating a seamless cooking experience. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a vibrant, family-friendly community at the centre of the city, known for its circular layout of landscaped parks, low- and mid-rise residential buildings and townhouses. Circle Mall, the community park network, neighbourhood cafes, supermarkets, nurseries, schools and clinics cover daily needs close to home and give the area a green, relaxed character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect residents with the wider city. Dubai Marina, Business Bay and Mall of the Emirates are a short drive away, Downtown Dubai and Jumeirah Beach are close by, and Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach for frequent travellers and commuters.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular rental markets in Dubai. A central position between the coastal districts and the inland business hubs attracts young professionals and families, supporting high occupancy and steady demand. Well-finished homes with resort-style amenities and competitive prices underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners.
